description: Flexa Design is a Power BI visual add-on that enables analysts and developers to craft stunning, user-friendly reports in seconds-no advanced design skills required. Key Features: Dynamic Button Library: Choose from toggle buttons, standard buttons, slicer buttons, and interactive menu buttons, paired with hundreds of intuitive icons. Flexible Layout Options: Design sleek sidebars or headers with modern shapes to elevate your reports. Effortless Design Tools: Streamline report styling, freeing analysts to focus on data analysis. With Flexa Design, you can transform your Power BI reports into visually appealing, professional dashboards in just minutes— bringing your data to life visually and effortlessly. For licensing and commercial use, please visit FlexaIntel.com .
